findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-readiness.ts:285 buildReviewGateRows does not mirror the real REVIEW→TEST gate for required active reviewer lanes. After any valid reviewer pass/finding exists, the readiness report only checks invalid bindings and open blocking findings, then emits no_open_blocking_review_findings at lines 335-344. The actual gate in packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:564-585 requires every opt-in reviewer lane in round 1 and quorum evaluation. This can make lifecycle_check report localReady or missing only validation while concept/quality/test-coverage lanes are still absent, violating the proof-or-stop contract and giving unsafe next-action guidance.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by ea1ad1ab9: lifecycle_check now derives required lanes from computeActiveReviewers and mirrors reviewer quorum via evaluateReviewerQuorum; build and lifecycle-check smoke pass.

findings.desc: lifecycle_check review readiness does not enforce required reviewer lanes. In buildReviewGateRows, once any finding/pass exists it validates bindings and only checks for open blocking findings, then emits no_open_blocking_review_findings. It never computes active reviewers or missing lanes. The live REVIEW->TEST gate requires round-1 evidence from every active reviewer via computeActiveReviewers, and baseline reviewers are concept, quality, and test-coverage. The V1 spec also says review pass condition is required lanes have current pass and no blocking verified finding. Result: after a single reviewer pass, lifecycle_check can report TEST/DONE review readiness while story_advance REVIEW->TEST still blocks missing reviewer lanes, creating a competing readiness truth source.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by ea1ad1ab9: missing required concept/quality/test-coverage lanes now produce blocking readiness rows with exact review_run_start commands; no competing review truth source remains.

findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:0 is not actually covered by lifecycle-check-smoke. The intent requires proving format=json and --json produce the same top-level report shape without mutating story files, but packages/main/src/tasks/lifecycle-check-smoke.ts only exercises json:true at lines 156-157 and format:"text" at lines 180-185; it never calls format:"json" or compares it with json:true. The recorded verificationEvidence for CHK-001:edge:0 points to npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-check-smoke, so the evidence overclaims this edge intent. Add a smoke assertion that invokes both json:true and format:"json", compares their top-level report shape, and keeps the no-mutation snapshot around both calls.
